These are behavioral dislocations: forced buying, FOMO, and short-gamma effects in names with high retail ownership and elevated implied correlation to NVDA. We also add a small structural long in energy (XLE) as a hedge against a hawkish FOMC repricing and geopolitical tail risk, which is under-priced in a complacent VIX 15.2 environment.
